service.description: The draft of a work item import of the current user: the draft map (empty when there is none, or the id is not a draft id), the location of its file, and the folder.

actions.script: draft = {} found = false fileLocation = null const userId = ec.user.userId if (!userId || !importId || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}$/.test(String(importId))) return folder = `dbresource://ironstone/WorkItemImport/${userId}/${importId}` const text = ec.resource.getLocationReference(folder + '/draft.json').getText() if (!text) return try { draft = JSON.parse(text) || {} } catch (err) { ec.logger.warn(`Work item import ${importId} of ${userId}: the draft does not read: ${err}`); draft = {}; return } found = true fileLocation = folder + '/source.csv'

service.description: Merges the fields given into the draft of a work item import of the current user and saves it.
The projects a work item import may go into: the open projects the user may add work to (members and managers).

The import's first step: the file (an upload, or the file already in the draft when none is given) read as text in its character set (mantle.party.ContactImportServices.read#ContactFileText), kept as the draft's source file, and parsed (mantle.work.WorkItemImportServices.parse#WorkItemFile) for its preset, columns, mapping and value maps, which start the draft; the project the items go into, one the user may work in. A new import gets an id; the same importId replaces its file (and its mapping, when the file or preset changed).

The mapping step's data: the draft, the file's columns (name, count, first values), the target fields with the column each takes now, the file's types, statuses and priorities each with the value it maps to, and the options of each (the project's work item types, the statuses of its flow, priorities 1 to 9).

The import's last step: mantle.work.WorkItemImportServices.import#WorkItems of the draft's file with its project, mapping, value maps and options (each row in its own transaction: a row that fails is named with its reason and the rest are imported), the result kept in the draft (counts, the failures with their reasons and values, the warnings) for the result view and the failures download. A file of up to 100 rows is imported in the request; a larger one (or background true) runs on as a job (run#ImportNow): the draft is running, the user gets the progress on the topic workItemImportProgress (progressKey the importId), and the draft ends done or failed. An import running or done is not started again.

Imports the draft's file now (for run#Import, in the request or as its job, as the user who started it), then the draft done with its result. An import that stops (an error before the rows) leaves the draft failed with the error, never running, so it can be run again.
